## X-Sense Home Security v1.4.17

### 📷 Cameras
- Hides **X-Sense Recordings** from the Home Assistant Media Browser when the account has no supported X-Sense cameras.
- Registers the recordings panel, services, and media source only while camera entities are present, and removes them again when the last camera goes away.
- Fixes invalid configuration on newer Home Assistant versions that use lazy media-source platform loading.
- Lets the recordings runtime reload cleanly without a full Home Assistant restart.
- Restores the WebRTC signal timing used by the previously working camera live-view path.
- Queues Home Assistant ICE candidates until the X-Sense camera returns an SDP answer, then forwards them.
- Removes unused direct RTSP/RTMP live-view API helpers; live view stays on the Home Assistant WebRTC signal-relay path.

### 🔐 Login
- Normalizes Cognito passwords to match APK 1400 login behavior by trimming whitespace and using the first 50 characters before SRP authentication.
- Fixes `NotAuthorizedException` logins for accounts whose X-Sense mobile app password is longer than Home Assistant previously sent to Cognito.

### 🌍 Translations
- Adds full Home Assistant translation coverage for the integration UI, services, and recordings panel across supported locales.

### 🔒 Maintenance
- Restores the CodeQL workflow path and clears remaining hassfest and workflow warnings.
- Addresses CodeQL security findings in the integration and recordings panel frontend.
- Stops logging sensitive recordings panel debug payload details.
- Bumps Go adapter security dependencies.
